_comment: Listed instruments = projects. tier: main | otc | delisted. Private repos get no link.

listings.name: Grayr: confidential agent payments
listings.line: ZK shielded USDC pool on Base. AI agents pay x402 APIs without revealing who paid, with refunds and escrow.

listings.name: Anna: NNUE chess engine
listings.line: Rust UCI engine with threat-aware NNUE nets, a 3,578 blitz rating, gated on SPRT.

listings.name: latencytax: C++20 matching engine
listings.line: ITCH/OUCH order book at 17M msg/s, 0 mismatches on 25.6M level checks against Hyperliquid.

listings.name: AlphaData: crypto research data
listings.line: 142,775 SHA-256-verified datasets from 24 live collectors across 30 venues.

listings.name: Riverline: can an LLM play poker?
listings.line: Measures an LLM poker policy's exact exploitability against solved equilibria in Kuhn and Leduc poker.

listings.name: rreview: on-device chess reviews
listings.line: Free, unlimited game reviews with Stockfish 19 running on your phone. Share straight from Chess.com.

listings.name: FlowTO: 1st at NVIDIA Spark Hacks
listings.line: GNN traffic model for Toronto, 0.93 R² across 73,000+ road edges.

listings.name: TradeOff: 1st at NexHacks
listings.line: Hedges stock portfolios with prediction markets, matching exposures to 6,000+ Polymarket markets.

listings.name: carsearch: used-car market data
listings.line: Canadian used-car listings turned into a price-history database, exposed to agents over MCP.

listings.name: avro: veAERO vote optimizer
listings.line: Prices Aerodrome fees and incentives on Base and recommends how to allocate veAERO votes.

listings.name: Slipstream Lab: LP backtester
listings.line: Concentrated-liquidity backtester with fee attribution within 0.002% of on-chain collects.
